row:
We are a female-owned and operated mobile veterinary practice working on livestock and equine in CT, NY, and MA. 
Our mission is to provide skilled and reliable veterinary services to livestock producers and large animal companion owners through science-based medicine, client education, and management ingenuity. 
"Keeping Livestock Healthy and Women Ferile Since 2019" - Dr. Lisa Dauten, DVM Tri-State Veterinarian and CEO
